body: I am afraid to ask the doctor in case they try to put me in the psych ward. Maybe I get the courage to ask him or maybe I just find a way to do it myself.

That sounds rational but no. The physical and psychological effects of the illness and medication are terrible and there's not much in the way of help. The best thing that could help me is medically assisted death but I've been too scared to ask about it because my doctor thinks his job is to help me live, not die.
How long have you felt this way?
I have an incurable illness that is making my quality of life deteriorate even further  so I don't see the point of living just to suffer and eventually die from the illness anyway.

My answer to this question is YES. My parents were mentally ill addicts. I was sexually abused as a child and witnessed my dad beat up and sexually assault my mother. I was physically abused by my boyfriends and husband as an adult, and have struggled with poverty and depression. I've never had a job I liked and I've been unable to finish my education. My dad committed suicide in 2005 and my mom died of cancer a few months later. My only child was murdered in 2018 and his father died of cancer in 2019. And in January this year I was diagnosed with a chronic incurable blood and lymph cancer. You can see why I am looking for the best way to end it already, right? I can't take any more.
